description.value: A two-storey McDonald's location in Delta, BC offering drive-through, takeaway, and outdoor seating. As a full-service fast food restaurant on 56 Street, it serves as a convenient stop for touring cyclists passing through the area. The national rewards app offers app-exclusive deals that can be useful on longer rides.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: OSM tags confirm a McDonald's fast food outlet with drive_through=yes, takeaway=yes, and outdoor_seating=yes. The website is the national McDonald's Canada homepage (mcdonalds.ca) and provides no location-specific amenity data for this Delta branch, so most criteria remain null. The business is clearly real and open based on OSM data and the live national website.
concerns: Website URL points to the national McDonald's Canada homepage (mcdonalds.ca), not a location-specific page; no location-specific amenity details can be confirmed from the website content.
No phone number present in OSM record.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible McDonald's franchise location useful to touring cyclists for food, takeaway, and restroom access.
